announcements.headline: New Aivlosin® marketing authorisations

announcements.headline: ECOVAXXIN® MG marketing authorisation application
announcements.insight: Following September safety data approval, ECO Animal Health Group has applied for marketing authorisation for ECOVAXXIN® MG. This advances the product pipeline licensed from Vaxinano in August.

announcements.headline: Capital Markets Day
announcements.insight: ECO Animal Health Group hosts a Capital Markets Day to present its strategy, following recent licensing and regulatory milestones. Shareholders should watch for details on how these developments drive future growth.

announcements.headline: USDA-CVB approves ECOVAXXIN® MS field safety data
announcements.insight: USDA-CVB approval of ECOVAXXIN® MS field safety data follows the August in-licensing agreement. This regulatory milestone supports the commercialization of the newly licensed asset.

announcements.headline: Share Awards to Executive Directors
announcements.insight: Executive directors receive share awards, aligning incentives with long-term value creation. This follows recent director purchases and licensing activity.

announcements.headline: Exclusive in-licensing agreement with Vaxinano
announcements.insight: ECO Animal Health Group secured an exclusive in-licensing agreement. This follows its recent EU product launch and positive annual results.

announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the CEO's recent share purchase alongside the AGM posting. This follows the July results and credit facility renewal.

announcements.headline: Results for the year ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: Annual results follow a credit facility renewal and EU product launch. Shareholders should watch for financial performance details.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results
